children: Anthropic said some of its revenue comes from customers who violate its usage policy or commercial terms, and subsequently lose access after the company discovers the violations.

The company estimated that revenue from such customers represented 5% to 7% of revenue for the nine months ended in September, though it expects the percentage to fall as its detection and enforcement efforts grow stronger.
